help.root_after_help: Use --lang zh or --lang en to switch the CLI help language.

auth.login.remove.about: Remove an account by user ID.

auth.login.use.about: Switch the active account by user ID.

auth.logout.about: Logout from one or more accounts.

auth.status.about: Show the status of all accounts.

upload.about: Upload files or directories to Telegram.

download.about: Download files from Telegram message URLs.

forward.about: Forward messages from one chat to another.

service.about: Run in long-lived service mode over stdio or HTTP.

args.help: Print help for the current command.
args.lang: CLI help language. Supports zh and en.
args.name: Optional account display name.
args.include: Only include the specified file extensions.
args.from_chat: Source chat used with plain message IDs.
args.drop_author: Send as copy without the forward header.
args.caption: Caption HTML sent as-is.
args.group: Send files as a media group.
args.json_events: Print machine-readable lifecycle events for stdio clients.
args.http_bind: Serve the HTTP API on host:port instead of stdio mode.

command_args.root.lang: CLI help language. Supported values: zh, en.
command_args.auth.logout.id: User ID to logout. Uses the active account when omitted.
command_args.auth.login.add.method: Login method. Supported values: phone, qr.
command_args.upload.chat: Destination chat ID or username. Defaults to Saved Messages.
command_args.upload.account: Account user ID(s) to use. Defaults to the active account.
command_args.upload.to: Destination peer expression. Conflicts with --chat and --topic.
command_args.upload.group: Send files as a media group or album. Maximum 10 per group.
command_args.download.path: Output directory. Defaults to the current directory.
command_args.download.account: Account user ID to use. Defaults to the active account.
command_args.download.template: Filename template used for saved files.
command_args.forward.from: Source message URLs or plain message IDs.
command_args.forward.from_chat: Source chat required when --from uses plain message IDs.
command_args.forward.to: Destination chat ID or username. Defaults to Saved Messages.
command_args.forward.mode: Forward mode. Supported values: direct, clone, smart.
command_args.forward.account: Account user ID to use. Defaults to the active account.
command_args.service.http_bind: Listen on host:port and expose the HTTP API.
command_args.service.json_events: Emit JSON lifecycle events in stdio service mode.
